# The Workstation's dock projections lose to the engine's value sheets

## Context

The visual suite's `PreviewLanguageVisual` light arm is red on `dev` (`1e68b3a3fd`). My defect-note 11902f25 (11-07) measured it on `6a88a7cbb2`:

```
NEO_E2E_PORT=8117 npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.visual.mjs test/playwright/visual/PreviewLanguageVisual.spec.mjs
the pair in light mode — the daylight deep-pigment signal
  528 pixels (ratio 0.01 of all image pixels) are different.
```

The reported 528 is only the above-threshold subset. A raw byte compare of expected against actual gives **57,840 differing pixels**: 57,617 in the DEFAULT column and 223 in SIGNAL GLOW. They are two separate changes.

1. **The DEFAULT inactive drop-indicator chip:** `60,64,72` → `246,248,251`. The chip paints `var(--dock-preview-ground, rgb(28 33 40 / 92%))`. The golden was minted on 2026-07-16 (#15208), before `d147755216` (2026-08-17, #17293) gave neo-light its own `--dock-preview-ground`. **The golden recorded the dark fallback**, the state the rule's own comment calls a defect ("would leave unthemed- light hosts painting dark chrome"). Current `dev` is right here.
2. **The DEFAULT accepted zone and split bar:** border `48,136,130` → `46,162,152`, bar `44,134,128` → `42,160,150`. In the golden they matched SIGNAL GLOW exactly; now they don't. **This is a regression.** It sits below the per-pixel threshold, which is why the arm reports only the chip.

## The Problem

A probe in the light arm, after the theme swap, read 2/2:

```
--agent-dock-preview-accept  on the DEFAULT column : #0d9488   (engine theme value)
--workstation-signal         on the same element   : #0f766e   (the app's own pigment)
theme-neo-light sheet order : apps/workstation/Viewport.css → dashboard/Container.css → dashboard/dock/interaction/Preview.css
```

The Workstation projects `--agent-dock-preview-accept: var(--workstation-signal)` in `resources/scss/theme-neo-light/apps/workstation/Viewport.scss:23`. The engine's dock values layer declares `#0d9488` for the same token (`resources/scss/theme-neo-light/dashboard/_preview-accents.scss:15`, included by `dashboard/Container.scss` and `dashboard/dock/interaction/Preview.scss`). Since #18747 (2026-09-15) **both declare at `:where(.neo-theme-neo-light)`**. That sweep moved the two Workstation sheets from `:root .neo-theme-neo-*` (0,2,0) to `:where()` (0,0,0), so the tie goes to load order. The engine appends its per-class sheets after the app's, so the engine wins.

A resolved census of the tokens both layers declare (app `var(--workstation-*)` references resolved through the app's own palette):

| theme | shared tokens | resolve differently |
|---|---|---|
| neo-light | 11 | `--agent-dock-preview-accept` (`#0f766e` app / `#0d9488` engine), `--agent-dock-preview-accept-fill`, `--agent-dock-proxy-shadow` (`#f2f5f9` app / `rgba(90, 107, 128, 0.45)` engine) |
| neo-dark | 11 | none; every pair resolves equal, which is why the dark golden passes |

No other app sheet under `resources/scss/theme-neo-*/apps/` (23 per theme: covid, docs, portal) shares a token with an engine sheet.

## The Architectural Reality

- Design authority: `learn/guides/uibuildingblocks/StylingAndTheming.md:306-320`: "An application projects its own palette into an engine token family at theme-root … and expects to win … the engine appends its per-class theme sheets as components mount, after the application's own". The guide's own example application sheet, `theme-neo-dark/apps/myapp/Viewport.scss`, declares at `:root .neo-theme-neo-dark`.
- #18102, the policy ticket, names these exact sheets as **consumer projections**, not engine value sheets: "the Workstation's `--agent-dock-preview-*` projections at theme-root win cleanly even though the theme declares `--agent-dock-preview-signal-ground` itself". #18747's sweep took them along with the engine sheets; its commit body named this hazard for its first batch ("no token changes owner"), and in the `apps/` batch tokens did change owner.
- Both Workstation sheets are a single root block of custom properties only, with no structural rules, so their weight decides only the 11 token contests above.
- The visual tier is local-only and refreshes by `--update-snapshots`, and "a refreshed golden is a reviewed design decision (the PR diff is the review surface)" (`PreviewLanguageVisual.spec.mjs` header; #18694 scoped this tier out of its pixel-policy work because it has that arbiter).

## The Fix

1. `resources/scss/theme-neo-{light,dark}/apps/workstation/Viewport.scss` declare at `:root .neo-theme-neo-{light,dark}` again, each with a one-line comment naming the rule (an application projection outranks the engine's `:where()` value sheets by weight).
2. Keep the `--agent-dock-proxy-shadow` projection in both sheets. `DockPreview.spec.mjs:122` requires the Workstation to project every dock alias in both modes.
   - Dark keeps `var(--workstation-ground)`.
   - Light's current value, the app's ground, is the near-invisible shadow that the engine's light values sheet replaced on purpose (`dashboard/Container.scss` comment). It becomes `color-mix(in srgb, var(--workstation-ink-dim) 45%, transparent)`. That is exactly the engine's `rgba(90, 107, 128, 0.45)`, which the drag proxy carries today, now derived from the app's palette.
3. Re-mint `preview-language-pair-light.png` with `--update-snapshots`, and only after 1. The re-mint must then differ from the July golden by the chip alone.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: In the Workstation light theme, `--agent-dock-preview-accept` and `-accept-fill` compute to the app's values (`#0f766e`, `rgba(15, 118, 110, 0.14)`) on the DEFAULT preview column. Probe receipt in the PR.
- [ ] AC-2: Before the re-mint, the July golden and the fixed render differ above the per-pixel threshold only in the DEFAULT inactive chip. The DEFAULT zone border and split bar match the golden byte for byte. The raw residue outside the chip is the board's rounded-corner backdrop (the Workstation behind the board) and label antialiasing. Neither comes from this change.
- [ ] AC-3: The visual suite passes locally, all arms; the dark golden is untouched.
- [ ] AC-4: The light drag proxy keeps its current computed shadow (`rgba(90, 107, 128, 0.45)`).

## Out of Scope

- The 46 other `apps/` sheets: none shares a token with an engine sheet (census above), so their weight decides nothing today.
- Whether the visual tier joins CI: #18694's ground, decided there.

## Avoided Traps

- **Re-minting the golden alone.** It would freeze the regression into the arm that exists to catch it.
- **Changing the engine's light `--agent-dock-preview-accept` to `#0f766e`.** The engine default serves every host; the Workstation's identity belongs in its projection.
- **Element-scoped bridges** (`body:has(.workstation-viewport) …`). #18102 retired that pattern for exactly this case: theme-root weight is the documented contract.
